== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Imperial Steward]] is a high-ranking leadership role within the [[Aurelian Empire]], currently held by [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. The position serves as a caretaker and protector of the people, acting as a temporary ruler who sits upon the throne until a true Emperor can be officially declared. The role is supported by various [[Guilds]] and requires the use of specific imperial regalia, including the Emperor's clothing, a [[silver crown]], and specialized armor. While the Steward acts as a representative of the citizenry, the position is subject to political complexities involving [[Imperial]] [[Regents]] and [[Guild]] leaders. [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] also serves as a Captain, specifically commanding the vessel known as [[The Testament]]. In his capacity as a [[Navigator]] and Captain, he possesses the ability to [[Read]] his ship and navigate the [[Aion Sea]]. His dual responsibilities involve managing maritime security against threats like [[Elderspawn]] and addressing imperial crises, such as atmospheric anomalies. The Steward's duties include delivering official addresses to the capital and maintaining the stability of [[The Empire|the Empire]] amidst increasing Elder activity.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] holds the title of Steward and is referred to as the Captain by [[Jerri]]. [[Calder]] also maintains a grudge against [[Shera]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] holds the title of Steward, a role through which he communicates by sending messages via senior [[Guards]]. Following an incident that leaves the Steward's body pulseless and bleeding, his armored form must be stripped. During these events, a young girl with hair even redder than the Captain's is present. While [[Jerri]] addresses [[Calder]] as the Captain, he contemplates reclaiming his former position as a means to eventually settle his grudge against [[Shera]].}}
